headline: Diesel prices have surged, completely cancelling the excise cut. What a full tank now costs
summary: Diesel prices in Romania have risen sharply in recent months, fully offsetting the excise cut. A litre of standard diesel reached 10.43-10.52 lei on 13 September, up from 8.27 lei in late February.
why: Fuel prices feed directly into transport costs, inflation and consumer spending across the economy. Changes in excise duties are a common government lever to ease the cost of fuel.
